name: PivotLineCells
description: Collection of PivotCell objects for a specific PivotLine.
remarks: Use the PivotLineCells (_index_) property of the PivotLine object to return or specify the location of a specific PivotCell object in the collection. You can also specify a PivotField object or the PivotField name to return a single PivotCell object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified PivotLineCells object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a specific element of the PivotLineCells collection object by its position in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the PivotLineCells collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Full
properties.description: When True, all of the PivotLineCells in the PivotLine (including those that are hidden in compact form) are retrieved. Read-only Boolean.
